prose: David Whitehead is the creator of Way of the Truth Warrior and co-host of Unslaved Podcast. We discuss how to cultivate self-esteem, perhaps the most important aspect of enlightenment. We also demystify shadow work and psycho-somatic healing, and discuss the importance of individual sovereignty in a tyrannical world.
topics: The enlightening aspects of martial arts
Wilhelm Reich and Listen, Little Man!
The three foundational aspects of self-esteem: rationality, reason, and freewill
Nathaniel Branden, The Six Pillars of Self-Esteem
ext: Why Philosophical and Political Anarchy aren't compatible
